shots.js: let tot=0; __G.scene.traverse(o=>{ if(!o.isMesh||!o.visible) return; const g=o.geometry; let t=(g.index?g.index.count:g.attributes.position.count)/3; tot+=t*(o.isInstancedMesh?o.count:1); }); Math.round(tot/1000)+'k tris'
